verdict.rationale: iTerm2 documents automation surfaces: the Python API, AppleScript with an AutoLaunch script file, and regex triggers. Nothing in the evidence shows a built-in way to version, review, or roll back those automations. Keeping script files in an external VCS would be a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
